name: Moraine
description: Glacial till: blocks of every size dumped in a ridge where the ice stopped.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: @rand(2%, 30%); top: @rand(2%, 30%); @size: @rand(38%, 68%); background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); border-radius: @pick(0, 18%, 50%); -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 18deg, 36deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 18deg, 36deg)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
